source: HydroRIVERS v1.0 (Lehner & Grill 2013), clipped to geoBoundaries GIN ADM1
note: Each entry in `aois` is a TILE, not a whole river system -- see the module docstring ('A whole river system is not one fetch'). `systems` groups tile keys by MAIN_RIV for reporting. est_water_fraction is REPORTED, not enforced; rivers are gated on absolute water pixel count (DETECTION_CONFIG['min_water_px']).
